title: Recompute scope-guard pauses and classify auth stops as environment
summary: Root cause: the guard stores a pause as a file and classifies a stop only by the closing-reason prefix. A pause therefore outlives rule changes or environment-only spend, and auth/usage stops (401, 20261028-103330-3d47) count as work failures. Fix: derive the pause from per-attempt stop reasons on every check, and classify auth/usage stops as environment. Jobs 20261028-055601-hg0n, 20261028-065911-m6m5 and 20261028-103330-3d47 are addressed as described in the assumptions.

defaults_applied.how: All changes are Rust in crates/athena-core.
New unit tests; cargo test, clippy and fmt must pass.
Fix classification and pause derivation in the guard, not one job's pause.
Criteria run tests that fail on base and pass with the change.
Verifier runs cargo test, clippy and fmt --check.
The check is that environment-only spend no longer pauses a line.
One focused change in the scope guard and the stop-reason classification.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: crates/athena-core/src/scope_guard.rs (attempt_of classifies Verdict::Environment only by ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX on the closing reason; try_watch_line writes the pause file and, when no signal fires, removes only the flag file; line_pause reads the stored pause file; t3_basis and counted already exclude environment stops), crates/athena-core/src/disk.rs (is_environment_reason accepts only LOW_DISK and CHECK_TIMEOUT; resumable_stop), crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs line 680 and run/producer.rs line 206 (the 'the producer did not complete' closing reasons with no environment prefix; run/mod.rs line 695 refuses a paused line). Entry points are Athena::go and Athena::retry via line_pause. Tests are the unit tests in scope_guard.rs, measured directly on AttemptRecord/request_records output and on line_pause results. No record or data file is added, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are not touched.

Goal and audience: the person running Athena must not see a line paused because of spend caused by the environment (low disk, expired login, usage limit). Audience is the owner who lifts pauses and the verifier running cargo test.

Job 20261028-055601-hg0n, 20261028-065911-m6m5 and 20261028-103330-3d47: their replay-feature candidates (check-reading, athena.replay/1) are a different task whose jobs were stopped by the environment. That work is dropped here: the files they changed (CHANGELOG.md, crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs, crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs, crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs, crates/athena-core/src/store.rs, crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs, crates/athena-data/src/records.rs, docs/records.md) are excluded in out_of_scope, except run/mod.rs and CHANGELOG.md, which this change may touch. Their low-disk and 401 findings are the failure class fixed here, not re-run. Job 20261028-103330-3d47 had no candidate.

The existing environment-stop handling for low disk is kept; the change extends the classification and makes pauses derived, not stored. A pause file whose recomputation no longer fires is removed or ignored.
Only changed behaviour is the guard; no reading or refusal rule for readings is added, so the replay-percent criterion does not apply.

acceptance_criteria.text: The change description (CHANGELOG.md entry) names the root cause: the guard stores a pause and classifies attempts only by a closing-reason prefix, so environment stops and stale pauses count as line spend; and it cites the jobs 20261028-055601-hg0n, 20261028-065911-m6m5, 20261028-103330-3d47.

In crates/athena-core/src/scope_guard.rs or disk.rs, a single classification function maps a closing reason (low disk, check timeout, expired login/401, usage limit) to Verdict::Environment; Grep shows attempt_of uses it and the producer-failure reasons in crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs and run/mod.rs carry the environment prefix for these causes.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core scope_guard`: a new test builds a line whose attempts all ended on environment stops (low disk, and a 401 auth stop) with spend above the T3 pause ratio, and asserts no pause; the same test fails on the base commit.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core scope_guard`: a new test writes a stale pause file for a line whose recomputed signals are none (or only environment stops) and asserts line_pause returns None and the stored pause is cleared, while a line with real runaway spend or two same-criterion rejections stays paused.
Run `cargo test`: the whole workspace test suite passes, including the existing scope_guard tests.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`: both are clean.

out_of_scope: The reading replay feature (athena check-reading, athena.replay/1 record, replay hold) from jobs 20261028-055601-hg0n, 20261028-065911-m6m5 and 20261028-103330-3d47; their changes to crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs, crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs, crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, crates/athena-core/src/store.rs, crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs, crates/athena-data/src/records.rs and docs/records.md are dropped
Changing the T1 to T5 thresholds
Automatic disk cleanup or reservation, and token refresh
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass probability than the reference because the change touches the guard's pause logic and several modules, and three earlier jobs on this line failed.
hard_reason: It changes the scope guard, a rule that can refuse or hold work (paused lines), and how pauses are decided and lifted.
